spells_by_level.name: Sinister Strike
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 8 ranks. Awards 1 combo point. Combat's builder (slow main hand). Efficient Strikes (Combat talent; Icy Veins still calls it Improved Sinister Strike) cuts its cost.
spells_by_level.flag: All rank levels and the 45 Energy cost come only from the endgametools client spell list (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Eviscerate
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 9 ranks. Damage per combo point, scales with Attack Power. Flawless Execution cuts its Energy cost (amount is a recorded conflict). wowfdb: only rank 6 is lower than Classic.
spells_by_level.flag: Levels after rank 1 come only from the endgametools client spell list (secondary); first rank cross-checked with wowfdb where noted. Rank 1 at level 1 also on wowfdb (utility page).

spells_by_level.name: Stealth
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 4 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown. Speed penalty 50/40/35/30% by rank (endgametools tooltips). Master of Deception, Camouflage and Night Elf Quickness improve it.

spells_by_level.name: Redirect
spells_by_level.notes: New in Forever. 10 s cooldown, melee range. Removes your combo points from the target and stores them for up to 15 s; they go to the next non-player enemy you hit with a melee or ranged ability.
spells_by_level.flag: Only the endgametools client spell list shows Redirect (secondary); no other archived page mentions it.

spells_by_level.name: Pick Lock
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link and conquestcapped Wowhead link (1804); warcrafttavern links the Lockpicking skill as 1809
spells_by_level.notes: Learn level is a recorded conflict (client lists 1; Icy Veins milestone puts the Lockpicking class quest at 15; conquestcapped/warcrafttavern/kickegg say the trainer teaches it at 16). Lockpicking is its own secondary skill line (wowfdb); cap = level x 5; 5 s cast, 5 yd, needs Thieves' Tools (item 5060) in the bags (conquestcapped).

spells_by_level.name: Backstab
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 9 ranks (endgametools lists ranks 8 and 9 both at 60). 150% weapon damage plus a bonus; must be behind the target; dagger in the main hand. Puncturing Wounds adds crit and a chance for an extra combo point.
spells_by_level.flag: All rank levels and the 60 Energy cost come only from the endgametools client spell list (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Pick Pocket
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Needed (with Stealth) for every level-10 class quest that steals an item. wowfdb and endgametools agree on level 4.

spells_by_level.name: Gouge
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 5 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown; 4 s incapacitate, target must face you, damage breaks it; awards 1 combo point. Improved Gouge (Assassination row 1) lengthens it.

spells_by_level.name: Evasion
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: +50% dodge for 15 s, 5 min cooldown. Endurance shortens the cooldown. Icy Veins: use it early and often while leveling.

spells_by_level.name: Sap
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Forever change: Sap no longer breaks Stealth (still needs Stealth; out-of-combat Humanoids; can't trigger weapon procs; sapping a PvP-flagged player flags you). Up to 25/35/45 s by rank. Dirty Tricks halves its cost; Quick Getaway allows 1 extra sapped target. Berserker Rage removes Sap (hotfix Nov 13).

spells_by_level.name: Slice and Dice
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks: +20% then +30% melee attack speed, 9-21 s by combo points. Improved Slice and Dice extends it.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank 2 level (42) comes only from endgametools; rank 1 at 10 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Sprint
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 3 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree): +50/60/70% speed for 15 s, 5 min cooldown, does not break stealth.

spells_by_level.name: Kick
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 4 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown, locks the school for 5 s; 25 Energy (Icy Veins). Improved Kick adds a 2 s silence.

spells_by_level.name: Expose Armor
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Forever change: armor reduction matches 5 Sunder Armor applications at about the same level (2,250 at 5 combo points at max rank) and it no longer prevents Sunder Armor; Sunder does not overwrite it unless weaker. Improved Expose Armor now cuts the cost and refunds combo points at 5 points.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 14 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 14 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Garrote
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks. Bleed from Stealth, behind the target (Dirty Deeds removes the facing requirement and cuts the cost). Icy Veins: the Subtlety opener once learned at 14; Ghostly Strike lets it work out of Stealth briefly.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 14 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 14 also on wowfdb and Icy Veins Subtlety leveling.

spells_by_level.name: Feint
spells_by_level.notes: 5 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 10 s cooldown. Threat reduction: Blizzard says doubled, wowfdb client data shows about five times (recorded conflict).

spells_by_level.name: Ambush
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks. 250% weapon damage plus a bonus; Stealth, behind the target, dagger in the main hand. Icy Veins Subtlety leveling milestone: Ambush unlock at 18. Ghostly Strike lets the next Ambush work out of Stealth.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 18 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 18 on wowfdb and Icy Veins.

spells_by_level.name: Poised
spells_by_level.notes: New in Forever. While at maximum Energy and out of combat, your next ability costs 10 less Energy. Composure (Combat) adds to the discount.

spells_by_level.name: Rupture
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks. Bleed finisher, 8-16 s by combo points. wowfdb: base damage cut by about 40% from Classic. Blood Splatter (+6 s), Serrated Blades (+30%) and Hemorrhage (+15% from the rogue) improve it.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels after 20 come only from endgametools; rank 1 at 20 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Distract
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Forever change: affected enemies also have reduced Stealth detection for 10 s (as if 1 level lower), and enemy players are told a rogue is near. 30 s cooldown, 30 yd. Improved Distract was removed in the Nov 2 rework.

spells_by_level.name: Vanish
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks (wowfdb and endgametools agree). 5 min cooldown; improved stealth for 10 s, breaks movement impairing effects. Costs 1 Flash Powder (item 5140, endgametools) unless the Legacy perk Reagent Economy is taken (wowfdb). Icy Veins milestone: Vanish unlock at 22.

spells_by_level.name: Shank
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: New in Forever. Off-hand strike for 50% weapon damage, generates 15 Energy (25 at rank 2), 10 s cooldown, cannot miss. Triggers Venom (Assassination); Boot Knife makes it add 2 combo points; Flash of Steel adds Energy and cuts the cooldown. Hotfix Nov 16: no longer removes combo points on other targets without Boot Knife. Icy Veins Subtlety leveling: learned at 24, use on cooldown.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank 2 level (44) and the rank-2 Energy gain come only from endgametools; level 24 is on wowfdb and Icy Veins.

spells_by_level.name: Detect Traps
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Passive. Needed for The Manor, Ravenholdt (Icy Veins class quests).

spells_by_level.name: Cheap Shot
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Stuns for 4 s from Stealth, awards 2 combo points. Icy Veins milestone: Cheap Shot unlock at 26. Dirty Deeds cuts the cost; Initiative adds a point.

spells_by_level.name: Disarm Trap
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 s cast, 5 yd; needs Thieves' Tools (endgametools tooltip).

spells_by_level.name: Kidney Shot
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks: stun 1-5 s (rank 2: 2-6 s) by combo points, 20 s cooldown. Improved Kidney Shot makes stunned targets take 10% more damage from your attacks and poisons.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank 2 level (50) comes only from endgametools; rank 1 at 30 also on wowfdb.

spells_by_level.name: Blind
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 10 s disorient, 10 yd, 5 min cooldown; needs Blinding Powder (item 5530 per endgametools; made with the Poisons skill from 34 per wowfdb). Icy Veins milestone: Blind unlock at 34. Dirty Tricks halves the cost; Elusiveness shortens the cooldown.

spells_by_level.name: Safe Fall
spells_by_level.notes: Passive: reduces falling damage.

spells_by_level.name: Riposte (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Combat row 3, 1 point (10 points in Combat, reachable at 20). Usable after you parry: 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 s. Icy Veins: Riposte at 20 is a big leveling power spike; use it whenever it procs.

spells_by_level.name: Premeditation (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 3, 1 point (reachable at 20). Adds 2 combo points; use or add to them within 20 s.

spells_by_level.name: Cold Blood (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Assassination row 4, 1 point (16-point medal, reachable at 25). Next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate or Mutilate is a guaranteed crit. Icy Veins: pair it with a 5-point Eviscerate.

spells_by_level.name: Ghostly Strike (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 4, 1 point (16-point medal, reachable at 25). 125% weapon damage (180% with a main-hand dagger), +15% dodge for 7 s, and your next Ambush or Garrote within 7 s works without Stealth. Icy Veins: use on cooldown, follow with Garrote.

spells_by_level.name: Blade Flurry (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Combat row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30). +20% melee attack speed and melee attacks hit an extra nearby enemy for 15 s. Icy Veins milestone: Blade Flurry at 30.

spells_by_level.name: Hemorrhage (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30; Icy Veins 'earliest possible Hemorrhage' at 30). 100% weapon damage (145% with a dagger), target takes 15% more Rupture and Garrote damage from you for 15 s, 1 combo point. Icy Veins: costs only 30 Energy; Subtlety's only builder once learned.

spells_by_level.name: Preparation (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30). Finishes the cooldown of your other Rogue abilities (Icy Veins: not Shank).

spells_by_level.name: Venom (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins calculator data 70959 (rank spell id); Icy Veins guide pages link Venom as 1310703
spells_by_level.notes: Assassination row 5, 1 point (reachable at 30; Icy Veins milestone 'Venom available through talents' at 30). Passive: Shank raises your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 s. Replaced the deep dive's 31-point Venom finisher.

spells_by_level.name: Adrenaline Rush (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Combat row 7, 1 point (reachable at 40). +100% Energy regeneration for 15 s. Icy Veins milestone: Adrenaline Rush at 40.

spells_by_level.name: Mutilate (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Assassination row 7, 1 point (30 points in the tree, reachable at 40 per the talent data and Icy Veins milestones). Both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus a bonus, +20% against poisoned targets, 2 combo points; needs daggers in both hands. 60 Energy (Blizzard deep dive, endgametools). Ranks 2 and 3 at 50/60 from endgametools. Learn level is a recorded conflict.

spells_by_level.name: Death Mark (talent)
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: Subtlety row 7 capstone, 1 point (reachable at 40), replaced Thousand Cuts. Finisher (a Curse) that marks the target and stores part of the damage your attacks deal per combo point (Garrote and Rupture at twice the rate); after 6 s the stored damage is dealt, up to a cap raised by Attack Power and crit. 25 Energy, 20 yd, 10 s cooldown (endgametools, wowfdb). Icy Veins: main finisher once learned.

spells_by_level.name: Poisons
spells_by_level.quest: Level-20 poison class quest (Alliance Mathias and the Defias / Klaven's Tower; Horde The Shattered Salute / Mission: Possible But Not Probable)
spells_by_level.notes: Poisons is its own secondary skill line with a spellbook tab (like First Aid); each poison rank is an item you make. Unlocked by the level-20 class quest (Icy Veins). wowfdb notes quest data teaching it at 24-26 (recorded conflict).

spells_by_level.name: Instant Poison
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 6 ranks; 30 min on a weapon; 20% chance per hit; charges 60/85/105/(1800 tooltip bug)/150/250. Base damage a third lower than Classic, attack-power coefficient 0.01 (wowfdb). Icy Veins: main hand.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels and charges come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Crippling Poison
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 2 ranks; 30% chance per hit, 50% (rank 2: 70%) slow for 12 s. Icy Veins: for mobs that run.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Mind-numbing Poison
spells_by_level.notes: 3 ranks; 20% chance per hit; casting time +40/50/60%; 75/115/225 charges.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Deadly Poison
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins db link (rank of the linked id not stated; match by name)
spells_by_level.notes: 5 ranks; 30% chance per hit, stacks 5 times; charges 90/115/135/240/240 in the wowfdb table (its note says 180 at rank V). Attack-power coefficient 0.009. Icy Veins: off hand, keep 5 stacks.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels and charges come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Wound Poison
spells_by_level.notes: 4 ranks; 30% chance per hit, stacks 5 times, reduces healing received. Mostly PvP.
spells_by_level.flag: Rank levels come only from wowfdb (secondary).

spells_by_level.name: Blinding Powder
spells_by_level.id_source: Icy Veins Subtlety leveling link (6510)
spells_by_level.notes: Made with the Poisons skill from 34; reagent for Blind.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Malice
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Ruthlessness
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Expose Armor
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Vigor
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases your maximum Energy by 10. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Blood Splatter
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 6 sec and your Garrote ability by 9 sec. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Lethality
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Vile Poisons
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Cold Blood
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Poisons
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Relentless Strikes
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 5, reachable at level 30. Max rank: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Venom
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 5, reachable at level 30. Max rank: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 5, reachable at level 30. Max rank: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Seal Fate
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 6, reachable at level 35. Max rank: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Mutilate
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 7, reachable at level 40. Max rank: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Coup de Grace
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Efficient Strikes
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 5. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Lightning Reflexes
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 1, reachable at level 10. Max rank: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Puncturing Wounds
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Deflection
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Increases your Parry chance by 6%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Precision
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Improves your chance to hit by 3%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Sprint
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 2, reachable at level 15. Max rank: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Endurance
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Riposte
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Composure
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 3, reachable at level 20. Max rank: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by 10. (calculator marks it 'new')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Kick
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Flawless Execution
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Weapon Expertise
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Aggression
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Row 4, reachable at level 25. Max rank: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 15%. (calculator marks it 'changed')

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Dual Wield Specialization

talent_changes.change: Poisons: more charges on all poisons; can be applied together with temporary enchantments such as Weightstones and Sharpening Stones.
Distract also reduces affected enemies' Stealth detection for 10 s (and tells enemy players a rogue is near).
Expose Armor reduction raised to match 5 Sunder Armor applications at about the same level; it no longer prevents Sunder Armor, and Sunder does not overwrite it unless weaker.

Improved Gouge moved to Assassination row 1; Malice also covers Poisons; Improved Expose Armor redesigned (Energy cost cut, combo point refund at 5 points); Cold Blood moved to the 16-point medal and works with Mutilate; Improved Poisons adds a chance not to consume charges; Vigor became 2 points; Mutilate added as the 21-point medal (60 Energy, two daggers, 2 combo points); Seal Fate no longer needs Cold Blood and triggers once per Mutilate; Venom added as a 31-point 25-Energy finisher (+30% poison damage, +10% application).

Improved Eviscerate moved to row 1; Puncturing Wounds (was Improved Backstab) also crits Mutilate and can add a combo point; Deflection doubled; Precision covers spells and Poisons; Endurance is a percentage cut to Sprint and Evasion; Flawless Execution new 16-point medal (-10 Eviscerate Energy); Hack and Slash replaces Dagger/Mace/Sword/Fist Specialization and adds Axes; Weapon Expertise reduces dodge/parry; Aggression also boosts Backstab.

Camouflage, Setup, Initiative, Dirty Tricks (was Improved Sap; halves Sap/Blind cost), Improved Ambush, Ghostly Strike, Hemorrhage, Premeditation (16-point medal, 20 s), Serrated Blades, Dirty Deeds changed; new Improved Distract, Quietus, Cutthroat and Thousand Cuts (31-point). Sleight of Hand and Deadliness removed.

Venom became a passive row-5 talent that Shank triggers (+30% Poison damage, +20% Poison application, 6 s); Mutilate moved to row 7 (90% weapon damage); Blood Splatter added; Lethality 2 points; Relentless Strikes row 5, 5 points; Seal Fate 3 points; Improved Expose Armor row 2; Vigor row 3; Murder removed.

Improved Eviscerate became Coup de Grace (also boosts Death Mark); Improved Sinister Strike became Efficient Strikes; new Composure (Poised discount) and Flash of Steel (Shank Energy and cooldown); Flawless Execution now -15 Eviscerate Energy (was 10); Aggression row 4 (Sinister Strike and Eviscerate +5/10/15%); Dual Wield Specialization row 5, 2 points; Improved Sprint row 2; Weapon Expertise row 4.

Thousand Cuts replaced by Death Mark (row-7 finisher curse, capstone at 40); Quietus became Quick Getaway; new Boot Knife (Shank adds 2 combo points); Cutthroat and Improved Distract removed, Ghostly Strike now lets the next Ambush work without Stealth; Hemorrhage also raises Garrote damage; Premeditation row 3; Opportunity 5 points; Setup row 1 (15/30/45%); Dirty Deeds row 2; Camouflage 3 points; Elusiveness row 4; Heightened Senses row 5.
Instant Poison attack-power coefficient 0.005 -> 0.01; Deadly Poison 0.0045 -> 0.009; Slice and Dice no longer stands a sitting target up.
Rogue Poison ranks can no longer go above the maximum rank; Shank no longer removes your combo points on other targets when Boot Knife is not talented.
Mutilate (and Execute) no longer get an extra attempt to activate Windfury Totem; Nov 13: off-hand strikes such as Mutilate's do not activate Windfury, the main-hand strike still does.
Shank tooltip now shows Rank 1 and Rank 2; with Boot Knife it shows the combo points granted.

rotations.assassination: Icy Veins Assassination (Nov 4, 2026), a priority list: 1) maintain buffs and debuffs: Poisons on both weapons (Instant Poison main hand, Deadly Poison off hand, keep 5 Deadly stacks), Expose Armor if no stronger armor debuff is on the target, Slice and Dice always, Rupture if the target will live through it; 2) open from Stealth with Garrote; 3) Shank on cooldown to keep Venom up (not when Energy is nearly full); 4) Mutilate to build combo points; 5) at 5 combo points Eviscerate if Slice and Dice and Rupture are up and Shank is on cooldown. No AoE. Cooldowns: Cold Blood with a 5-point Eviscerate once threat is established; Vanish for mechanics, threat drop or a Garrote refresh. Leveling (Icy Veins, Nov 18): Instant Poison on both weapons (Crippling Poison for runners), open with Cheap Shot or Garrote, Backstab (Sinister Strike if you can't get behind; Mutilate from 40), Slice and Dice if more targets are coming else Eviscerate at 5 combo points.
rotations.combat: Icy Veins Combat (Nov 4, 2026): maintain Poisons (Instant Poison main hand, Deadly Poison off hand), Expose Armor if no stronger armor debuff, Slice and Dice always, Rupture if the target will live; open from Stealth with Garrote; Shank on cooldown if it won't overcap Energy; Sinister Strike to build (Backstab in the dagger variant); at 5 combo points Eviscerate if Slice and Dice and Rupture are up and Shank is on cooldown. Blade Flurry whenever a second target is in range (or on cooldown for its attack speed); Adrenaline Rush after the opening Energy is spent and threat is established; Cold Blood on a 5-point Eviscerate; Vanish for mechanics or a threat drop. Leveling (Icy Veins, Nov 18): Instant Poison on both weapons (Crippling Poison for runners), open with Cheap Shot or Garrote, Riposte whenever it procs, Sinister Strike to build, Slice and Dice if you are confident there will be targets for its duration, else Eviscerate at 5 combo points; Blade Flurry from 30 for two targets.
rotations.subtlety: Icy Veins Subtlety (Nov 4, 2026): pool Energy around Death Mark windows. 1) maintain: Instant Poison main hand, Deadly Poison off hand; Rupture (5 combo points), Death Mark (5 combo points), Garrote if the target will live, Slice and Dice (5 combo points); 2) cooldowns: Shank on cooldown at 0-3 combo points (Boot Knife adds 2), Ghostly Strike on cooldown followed by Garrote (Initiative makes it 2 combo points), Premeditation on cooldown; 3) builders: Ambush as the Stealth opener, Hemorrhage as the main builder (30 Energy). Hold Vanish and Preparation for dangerous moments. Don't use multi-point generators at 4 combo points; stand behind the boss. Leveling (Icy Veins, Nov 4): Garrote to open once learned (14), Backstab or Sinister Strike to build until Hemorrhage (30), then Hemorrhage only; Shank and Ghostly Strike on cooldown; Slice and Dice early, Rupture on durable targets from 30, Death Mark as the main finisher from 40 (sample opener: Garrote, Hemorrhage, Shank to 5 combo points, Death Mark, then Hemorrhage and Eviscerate).
rotations.energy: Energy regenerates continuously at about 10 per second (Icy Veins; wowfdb: no longer in 2-second ticks); never overcap it. Combo points stay on a target when you switch targets and are lost only when you start building on another enemy or the target dies (Icy Veins, wowfdb). Energy refunds: Shank (+15, +25 at rank 2, Flash of Steel more), Relentless Strikes, Adrenaline Rush; Poised cuts the next ability by 10 Energy when you start a fight at full Energy. Switching specs no longer refills Energy (wowfdb, Oct 16).
rotations.poisons: Poisons are learned through the level-20 class quest and are their own skill line; each poison is an item made with that skill and lasts 30 minutes on a weapon. Icy Veins: Instant Poison on the main hand and Deadly Poison on the off hand at endgame; Instant Poison on both weapons while leveling, Crippling Poison for enemies that run. Forever: more charges, poisons can crit (Malice) and use hit (Precision), and Blizzard says a poison can sit on a weapon together with a Sharpening Stone or Weightstone (client data did not show the stacking yet per wowfdb). Venom (via Shank) and Improved Poisons are the Assassination poison talents. Some mobs are immune to poisons (Icy Veins).

race_notes.text: Forever Rogue races: Human, Dwarf, Gnome, Night Elf and High Order Skyborne (Alliance); Orc, Troll, Undead and Windshaper Skyborne (Horde) - every race except Tauren. Icy Veins (Nov 18): for Assassination and Combat, Undead (Touch of the Grave) is the best Horde race (Troll only wins against Beasts) and Gnome (Eureka!, Escape Artist) the best Alliance race. Subtlety: racial differences are very minor; Orc (Blood Fury) and Undead (slim edge) for Horde; Dwarf (+1% hit, Stoneform), Night Elf (burst racial, harder to detect) and Gnome (Escape Artist, Eureka!, +5% max Energy) for Alliance. Human Ruthless (+1% crit, no sword needed) is the Alliance Combat pick per wowfdb. Skyborne need the Skyborne Heroic Pack and start on Zephras Isle; Icy Veins says they get no level-10 class quest. Rip is a Human Rogue (Alliance): Ruthless crit; level-10 quest Seek out SI:7.

changes_log.change: Beta: Sap on a PvP-flagged target now flags the Rogue for PvP.

Beta: Blizzard announced Death Mark will replace Thousand Cuts; Shenthul (Orgrimmar) trains Windshaper Skyborne Rogues; a missed Expose Armor no longer costs combo points; Setup only adds points when your target is the enemy you dodged.

Blizzard Rogue and Warlock class deep dive: Sap keeps Stealth, Distract lowers detection, Expose Armor = 5 Sunders, Feint threat doubled, poisons with more charges stack with stones, one-handed axes, talent redesigns (Mutilate, Venom, Hack and Slash, Thousand Cuts).
Beta build 70291: several weapon swaps fit inside one global cooldown (swap macros can switch a whole set).

Beta: poisons no longer trigger against attackers; Sap can't trigger weapon procs; Cold Blood consumed when Mutilate crits; Human Sword Specialization replaced by Ruthless (+2% crit); Undead Touch of the Dead procs 20% for Rogues.
Beta: switching specializations no longer refills Energy.
Racials: Human Ruthless cut from 2% to 1% crit; Dwarf Artisan's Precision (+1% hit) replaces Earth Fury; Skyborne Wind Blessed 3% -> 2% haste.

Blizzard pre-launch notes (client 70755, datamined Nov 3): Shank (24) and Poised (18) added; talent rework (Venom passive via Shank, Mutilate row 7, Death Mark replaces Thousand Cuts, Coup de Grace, Efficient Strikes, Composure, Flash of Steel, Boot Knife, Quick Getaway, Blood Splatter; Murder, Cutthroat, Quietus, Improved Distract removed); Flawless Execution -15; poison AP coefficients doubled; training costs evened to 206-207 gold.
WoW Forever launch; wowfdb: Cutthroat removed, Ghostly Strike now lets the next Ambush work without Stealth; Death Mark is the Subtlety row-7 finisher.
Hotfix: Shank tooltip shows Rank 1 and Rank 2; with Boot Knife it shows the combo points granted.
Hotfix: restarting the Rogue quest 'Mission: Possible not Probable' works as intended.

Hotfix: Berserker Rage removes Sap; 'The Talisman of Kazdor' no longer sends rogues into the wrong version of Zul'Farrak; off-hand strikes (e.g. Mutilate's) don't activate Windfury Totem, main-hand strikes do.

Hotfix: Rogue Poison ranks can no longer exceed the maximum rank; Shank no longer removes combo points on other targets without Boot Knife; Mutilate no longer gets an extra Windfury Totem attempt; Witch Doctor Zum'rah spawns properly during 'The Talisman of Kazdor'.
Hotfix: various Paletusks can no longer be pickpocketed; a bin of mail in SI:7 lets Mathias Shaw give rogues the letter for 'The Manor, Ravenholdt'.
